title: Spectral inequalities for weighted $p$-Laplacians via Talenti symmetrization
summary: We consider the weighted $p$-Laplacian associated with a measure $μ$ that is absolutely continuous with respect to the Lebesgue measure on an open connected subset $X\subset\mathbb{R}^N$. We prove that Talenti's weighted Pólya--Szegő inequality -- originally established for Lipschitz functions on $X$ -- extends to Sobolev functions with zero boundary trace on arbitrary Borel subsets $Ω\subset X$.
